name: Nelli The Seer
detailed_description:
A STUDENT VIDEO GAME PROJECT

Nelli The Seer is a game developed by first-year students at a video game school.
The team had 14 weeks to deliver a third-person action-adventure game set in a historical temple. Game Design and Level Design students started pre-production first, followed three weeks later by the Environment Artists, Animators, and Character Riggers. The programmers joined the project seven weeks after the Game Designers.

Game Design and Level Design students had seven weeks of pre-production, while the Environment Artists, Character Rigger and Animator teams had four.
Then, all teams worked together during the final seven weeks of production to complete the game.

The result is a platformer blended with a memory-based puzzle game, offering about 30 minutes of gameplay.

NELLI, A FORMER AZTEC WARRIOR TURNED PRIEST

At the beginning of the 16th century, you play as Nelli, a young man from Tenochtitlan. Once a proud Aztec warrior, Nelli is granted the gift of foresight by Tezcatlipoca, the god of night and destiny. Upon discovering his new ability to see the future, he chooses to become a priest.

A DARK PROPHECY

In his final vision, Nelli sees a grim fate awaiting his people : soldiers will invade the great city of Tenochtitlan, capital of the Aztec Empire. Determined to warn his people, he seeks an audience with Emperor Moctezuma II.
However, the emperor does not believe him, Nelli’s prophecy contradicts those of the high priests.

NELLI'S QUEST

To prove his vision, Nelli ventures deep into the Templo Mayor.
His goal : to reassemble the Obsidian Mirror, a sacred relic of the Aztecs and the divine attribute of Tezcatlipoca.
Its fragments are scattered throughout the temple’s hidden chambers. Once the mirror is restored, Nelli hopes to convince the emperor of the truth.

CORE GAME MECHANICS

• Use Nelli’s athletic abilities : jump, climb, and crouch to reach areas inaccessible to ordinary people.
• Activate mystical mechanisms : open ancient stone doors, move platforms, and create new paths through the temple.
• Collect the Feather Gem to gain the ability to glide. This power lets you reach normally unreachable zones and interact with objects while falling.
• Harness Nelli’s gift of foresight: lie down on vision altars to extend your view into the future. Reveal hidden spikes, avoid sudden traps, and spot disappearing platforms.
Remember trap patterns and safe paths to complete your quest and fulfill your destiny.

short_description: Nelli The Seer is a third-person platformer and memory game. Jump, glide and see the future to collect the treasures present in the Templo Mayor. Collect the fragments of the obsidian mirror to show the future to your people.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel core i7-3770 3.40 GHz 4 cores
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960 6 Go
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 50-60 FPS LOW 1080p
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel core i7-12700KF 3.60 GHz 12 cores
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 12 Go
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 60-80 FPS EPIC 1080p
